title: Templates in Angular
description: Templates combine HTML with Angular's powerful declarative syntax to bind data and render dynamic UI.

blocks.text: Angular templates are HTML snippets enhanced with Angular-specific declarative syntax. They allow you to bind component model data directly into the DOM, listen to user input events, and control conditional rendering structures.
Use double curly braces `{{ }}` to render dynamic text values, or brackets `[property]` to bind directly to HTML element attributes:
Since Angular 17, the built-in control flow syntax replaces `*ngIf` and `*ngFor` with cleaner syntax, superior runtime performance, and compile-time TypeScript type checking:
The `track` expression in `@for` is required. It allows Angular to identify each item uniquely and optimize DOM reuse during list updates.
